lines.text: 옛날 옛날 산골 오막살이에 엄마와 오누이가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, a mom and her two children, a brother and a sister, lived in a little hut in the mountains.

lines.text: 엄마가 일하러 가요. 오누이를 톡 눌러서 인사해요!
lines.en: Mom is going to work. Tap the brother and sister to say goodbye!
segs: Mom is going to work. Tap the brother and sister to say goodbye!

lines.text: 오빠랑 동생을 톡 눌러서 "다녀오세요!" 해 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the brother and sister to say "Take care, Mom!"

lines.text: 엄마가 말했어요. "문 꼭 잠그고 엄마 기다려라~"
lines.en: Mom said, "Lock the door tight and wait for Mom~"
segs: Lock the door tight and wait for Mom~

lines.text: 엄마는 부잣집에서 하루 종일 부지런히 일했어요.
lines.en: Mom worked hard all day long at the rich family's house.

lines.text: "수고했어요. 떡 가져가요!" 떡을 톡톡 눌러서 바구니에 담아요!
lines.en: "Thank you for your hard work. Take these rice cakes!" Tap the rice cakes to put them in the basket!
segs: Thank you for your hard work. Take these rice cakes!
Tap the rice cakes to put them in the basket!

lines.text: 떡을 톡톡 눌러서 바구니에 담아요!
lines.en: Tap the rice cakes to put them in the basket!
segs: Tap the rice cakes to put them in the basket!

lines.text: 떡을 바구니 가득 받았어요! "우리 아이들이 좋아하겠다!" 엄마는 서둘러 집으로 떠났어요.
lines.en: The basket is full of rice cakes! "The children will love these!" Mom hurried off toward home.
segs: The basket is full of rice cakes!

lines.text: 떡 접시를 골라 톡 눌러요!
lines.en: Pick a plate of rice cakes and tap it!

lines.text: 반짝이는 접시예요! 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: That's the sparkly plate! Give it a tap!

lines.text: 호랑이 말풍선의 떡이랑 똑같이 생긴 접시를 골라요!
lines.en: Find the plate that matches the rice cakes in the tiger's speech bubble!

lines.text: 바구니에 남은 떡이랑 똑같은 개수의 접시를 골라요!
lines.en: Find the plate with the same number of rice cakes as the ones left in the basket!

lines.text: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 지고 있어요. 엄마가 첫째 고개를 넘어요.
lines.en: The sun is slowly setting. Mom is crossing the first hill.

lines.text: 하늘이 붉어졌어요. 엄마가 둘째 고개를 넘어요.
lines.en: The sky has turned red. Mom is crossing the second hill.
segs: The sky has turned red. Mom is crossing the second hill.

lines.text: 깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 엄마가 셋째 고개를 넘어요.
lines.en: It is a dark, dark night. Mom is crossing the third hill.
segs: It is a dark, dark night. Mom is crossing the third hill.

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 한 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me one rice cake, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me one rice cake, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 한 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants one rice cake. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 두 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me two rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me two rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 두 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants two rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 세 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me three rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me three rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 세 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants three rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 네 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me four rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me four rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 네 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants four rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 다섯 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me five rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me five rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 다섯 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants five rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 여섯 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me six rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me six rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 여섯 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants six rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 일곱 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me seven rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me seven rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 일곱 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants seven rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 여덟 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me eight rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me eight rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 여덟 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants eight rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 아홉 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me nine rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me nine rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 아홉 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants nine rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: "어흥! 떡 열 개 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me ten rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me ten rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이가 떡 열 개를 달래요. 어느 접시를 줄까요?
lines.en: The tiger wants ten rice cakes. Which plate should we give?

lines.text: 호랑이는 떡 한 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger gulps down one rice cake! What a round tummy!

lines.text: 호랑이는 떡 두 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger gulps down two rice cakes! What a round tummy!

lines.text: 호랑이는 떡 세 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger gulps down three rice cakes! What a round tummy!

lines.text: 호랑이는 떡 네 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger gulps down four rice cakes! What a round tummy!

lines.text: 호랑이는 떡 다섯 개를 꿀꺽! 배가 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: The tiger gulps down five rice cakes! What a round tummy!

lines.text: 떡 한 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! One more rice cake! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 두 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Two more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 세 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Three more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 네 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Four more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 다섯 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Five more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 여섯 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Six more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 일곱 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Seven more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 여덟 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Eight more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 아홉 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Nine more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: 떡 열 개를 또 꿀꺽! 배가 더 볼록해졌어요.
lines.en: Gulp! Ten more rice cakes! The tiger's tummy gets even rounder.

lines.text: "어흥! 남은 떡 몽땅 주면 안 잡아먹지!"
lines.en: "Roar! Give me all the leftover rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"
segs: Roar! Give me all the leftover rice cakes, and I won't eat you!

lines.text: 바구니에 남은 떡은 몇 개일까요? 세어 보고 접시를 골라요!
lines.en: How many rice cakes are left in the basket? Count them and pick a plate!

lines.text: 남은 떡을 몽땅 꿀꺽! 배가 빵빵해졌어요!
lines.en: The tiger gulps down all the leftover rice cakes! What a big, round tummy!

lines.text: 떡이 다 떨어지자 호랑이가 말했어요. "떡이 없으면 너를 잡아먹어야지!"
lines.en: When the rice cakes were all gone, the tiger said, "No more rice cakes? Then I'll have to eat you!"
segs: When the rice cakes were all gone, the tiger said,
No more rice cakes? Then I'll have to eat you!

lines.text: 호랑이는 엄마를 꿀꺽 잡아먹고 말았어요.
lines.en: The tiger ate Mom up with one big gulp.
segs: The tiger ate Mom up with one big gulp.

lines.text: 호랑이는 엄마 옷을 입고, 오누이가 기다리는 집으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The tiger put on Mom's clothes and went to the house where the brother and sister were waiting.
segs: The tiger put on Mom's clothes and went to the house where the brother and sister were waiting.

lines.text: 캄캄한 밤이 되었어요. 엄마는 아직 안 오셨어요.
lines.en: It was a pitch-dark night. Mom had not come home yet.
segs: It was a pitch-dark night. Mom had not come home yet.

lines.text: 등잔을 톡 눌러서 불을 켜 줄까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap the oil lamp to light it?

lines.text: 등잔을 톡 눌러서 불을 켜요!
lines.en: Tap the oil lamp to light it!

lines.text: 반짝! 방이 환해졌어요. 오누이는 창밖을 보며 엄마를 기다렸어요.
lines.en: Sparkle! The room glows. The brother and sister looked out the window and waited for Mom.

lines.text: 똑똑똑. "얘들아~ 엄마 왔다. 문 열어라~" 걸걸한 목소리예요.
lines.en: Knock, knock, knock. "Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~" The voice is rough and raspy.
segs: Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~
The voice is rough and raspy.

lines.text: 진짜 엄마 목소리를 톡 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the real Mom's voice!

lines.text: 반짝이는 쪽이 엄마 목소리예요!
lines.en: The sparkly one is Mom's voice!

lines.text: 오빠가 말했어요. "우리 엄마 목소리가 아니에요! 손을 보여 주세요!"
lines.en: The brother said, "That is not our mom's voice! Show us your hand!"
segs: That is not our mom's voice! Show us your hand!

lines.text: 진짜 엄마 손은 뭘까요? 잘 보고 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Which one is Mom's real hand? Look closely and pick!

lines.text: "어? 털이 복슬복슬… 줄무늬도 있네!"
lines.en: "Huh? It is furry... and it has stripes!"
segs: Huh? It is furry... and it has stripes!

lines.text: "어? 하얗긴 한데… 뾰족한 발톱이 있네!"
lines.en: "Huh? It is white, but... it has sharp claws!"
segs: Huh? It is white, but... it has sharp claws!

lines.text: 진짜 엄마 손을 톡 골라 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the real Mom's hand!

lines.text: 엄마 손은 손가락이 길쭉하고 떡가루가 묻어 있어요.
lines.en: Mom's hand has long fingers, with rice cake flour on it.

lines.text: 반짝이는 손이 엄마 손이에요!
lines.en: The sparkly hand is Mom's hand!

lines.text: 맞아요! 엄마 손은 부드럽고 떡가루가 묻어 있지요.
lines.en: That's right! Mom's hand is soft, with rice cake flour on it.
segs: That's right! Mom's hand is soft, with rice cake flour on it.

lines.text: 그런데 문틈으로 들어온 손은… 하얀 밀가루 사이로 발톱이 쏙! 엄마 손이 아니에요!
lines.en: But the hand through the crack in the door... Sharp claws poke out from the white flour! That is not Mom's hand!
segs: But the hand through the crack in the door... Sharp claws poke out from the white flour! That is not Mom's hand!

lines.text: 문밖에 누가 있는지 보고 싶어요. 창호지를 손가락으로 콕 뚫어 볼까요?
lines.en: We want to see who is outside. Shall we poke a little hole in the paper door with a finger?
segs: We want to see who is outside. Shall we poke a little hole in the paper door with a finger?

lines.text: 창호지를 톡 눌러서 콕 뚫어 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the paper door to poke a hole!

lines.text: 구멍 너머에 커다랗고 동그란 눈이 깜빡깜빡! 호랑이예요!
lines.en: Through the hole, a big round eye blinks and blinks! It is the tiger!
segs: Through the hole, a big round eye blinks and blinks! It is the tiger!

lines.text: 오빠가 속삭였어요. "쉿, 뒷문으로 살금살금 도망가자!"
lines.en: The brother whispered, "Shh, let's tiptoe out the back door!"
segs: Shh, let's tiptoe out the back door!

lines.text: 오누이는 뒷문으로 살금살금 나왔어요. 화면을 쓱 밀어서 달려요!
lines.en: The brother and sister tiptoed out the back door. Swipe the screen to run!
segs: The brother and sister tiptoed out the back door. Swipe the screen to run!

lines.text: 화면을 옆으로 쓱 밀어서 달려요!
lines.en: Swipe the screen sideways to run!

lines.text: 앗, 호랑이가 오는 소리! 커다란 장독을 톡 눌러서 숨어요!
lines.en: Oh no, the tiger is coming! Tap the big jar to hide!
segs: Oh no, the tiger is coming! Tap the big jar to hide!

lines.text: 커다란 장독을 톡 눌러서 숨어요!
lines.en: Tap the big jar to hide!

lines.text: "얘들아~ 어디 갔니?" 호랑이는 두리번두리번하다가 집 쪽으로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: "Kids~ where did you go?" The tiger looked around and around, then went back toward the house.
segs: The tiger looked around and around, then went back toward the house.

lines.text: 휴~ 이제 우물가 큰 나무로 달려가요! 쓱쓱!
lines.en: Phew~ Now run to the big tree by the well! Zoom, zoom!
segs: Phew~ Now run to the big tree by the well! Zoom, zoom!

lines.text: 우물가에 커다란 나무가 있어요. 톡톡 눌러서 영차영차 올라가요!
lines.en: There is a big tree by the well. Tap, tap, and climb up, heave-ho!

lines.text: 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 나무를 올라가요!
lines.en: Tap the screen again and again to climb the tree!

lines.text: 오누이는 나무 꼭대기까지 올라갔어요!
lines.en: The brother and sister climbed all the way to the top of the tree!
segs: The brother and sister climbed all the way to the top of the tree!

lines.text: 호랑이가 뒷마당에 왔어요. "옳지! 우물 속에 숨었구나!"
lines.en: The tiger came to the backyard. "Aha! They are hiding in the well!"
segs: The tiger came to the backyard.
Aha! They are hiding in the well!

lines.text: 호랑이가 우물 속을 들여다봤어요. 우물 물에 오누이 얼굴이 비쳤거든요!
lines.en: The tiger peeked into the well. The brother's and sister's faces were shining in the water!

lines.text: "두레박으로 건져야지~" 영차!
lines.en: "I'll scoop them up with the bucket~" Heave-ho!
segs: I'll scoop them up with the bucket~ Heave-ho!

lines.text: 첨벙! 두레박에는 물만 가득. 우물 속 오누이 얼굴을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Splash! The bucket is full of just water. Tap the faces of the brother and sister in the well!

lines.text: 우물에 비친 오누이 얼굴을 톡!
lines.en: Tap the faces in the well!

lines.text: 나무 위에서 오누이가 그만 킥킥 웃고 말았어요.
lines.en: Up in the tree, the brother and sister couldn't help giggling.

lines.text: "어? 위에서 웃음소리가?" 호랑이가 고개를 번쩍 들었어요.
lines.en: "Huh? A laugh from up above?" The tiger looked up with a jerk.
segs: Huh? A laugh from up above?
The tiger looked up with a jerk.

lines.text: 호랑이가 올려다보며 물었어요. "얘들아, 거기 어떻게 올라갔니?"
lines.en: The tiger looked up and asked, "Kids, how did you climb up there?"
segs: The tiger looked up and asked,
Kids, how did you climb up there?

lines.text: 오빠가 꾀를 냈어요. "참기름 바르고 올라왔지!"
lines.en: The brother thought up a trick. "We rubbed on sesame oil and climbed up!"
segs: The brother thought up a trick.
We rubbed on sesame oil and climbed up!

lines.text: 참기름 병을 톡 눌러서 나무에 발라 줘요!
lines.en: Tap the sesame oil bottle to rub the oil on the tree!

lines.text: 참기름 병을 톡!
lines.en: Tap the sesame oil bottle!

lines.text: 미끌 쭈르륵! 호랑이는 자꾸자꾸 미끄러졌어요.
lines.en: Slip, slide! The tiger kept on slipping down.
segs: Slip, slide! The tiger kept on slipping down.

lines.text: 그때 동생이 깔깔 웃으며 말해 버렸어요. "도끼로 콕콕 찍고 올라왔지~"
lines.en: Then the sister burst out laughing and blurted, "We chopped with an axe, chop, chop, and climbed up~"
segs: Then the sister burst out laughing and blurted,
We chopped with an axe, chop, chop, and climbed up~

lines.text: 오빠가 "쉿!" 했지만… 벌써 들어 버렸어요!
lines.en: The brother said "Shh!" but... it was too late! The tiger had already heard!
segs: but... it was too late! The tiger had already heard!

lines.text: 호랑이가 도끼로 콕콕 찍으며 올라와요! 오누이는 덜덜 떨었어요.
lines.en: The tiger is climbing up, chopping with an axe! The brother and sister shivered and shook.
segs: The tiger is climbing up, chopping with an axe! The brother and sister shivered and shook.

lines.text: 호랑이가 점점 가까이 올라와요. 오누이는 두 손을 모았어요.
lines.en: The tiger is getting closer and closer. The brother and sister put their hands together.
segs: The tiger is getting closer and closer. The brother and sister put their hands together.

lines.text: "하늘님, 튼튼한 동아줄을 내려 주세요!"
lines.en: "Dear Sky, please send down a strong rope!"
segs: Dear Sky, please send down a strong rope!

lines.text: 하늘에서 줄이 두 개 내려왔어요! 어떤 줄을 잡을까요?
lines.en: Two ropes came down from the sky! Which rope should we grab?

lines.text: 삐걱… 이 줄은 낡았어!
lines.en: Creak... This rope is old!

lines.text: 굵고 반짝이는 튼튼한 줄을 톡 골라요!
lines.en: Tap the thick, shiny, strong rope!

lines.text: 굵고 반짝반짝 튼튼한 줄을 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Look for the thick, sparkly, strong rope!

lines.text: 반짝이는 굵은 줄이 튼튼한 동아줄이에요!
lines.en: The thick, shiny rope is the strong rope!

lines.text: 맞아요! 굵고 반짝이는 새 동아줄이에요.
lines.en: That's right! It is the thick, shiny, new rope.
segs: That's right! It is the thick, shiny, new rope.

lines.text: 줄을 꼭 잡고, 화면을 위로 쓱쓱 밀어서 올라가요!
lines.en: Hold the rope tight and swipe the screen up to climb!

lines.text: 화면을 위로 쓱 밀어서 올라가요!
lines.en: Swipe the screen up to climb!

lines.text: 구름을 뚫고 쑥쑥!
lines.en: Up through the clouds, whoosh, whoosh!
segs: Up through the clouds, whoosh, whoosh!

lines.text: 구름을 여섯 겹이나 뚫고, 오누이는 하늘 나라에 닿았어요!
lines.en: Through six layers of clouds, the brother and sister reached the land in the sky!
segs: Through six layers of clouds, the brother and sister reached the land in the sky!

lines.text: 호랑이도 하늘에 빌었어요. 그랬더니 낡은 줄이 스르르 내려왔어요.
lines.en: The tiger prayed to the sky too. And an old rope slid slowly down.

lines.text: "아이코 내 엉덩이! 아이코 내 머리!" 호랑이 머리에 동그란 혹이 났어요.
lines.en: "Ouch, my bottom! Ouch, my head!" A round bump popped up on the tiger's head.
segs: Ouch, my bottom! Ouch, my head!
A round bump popped up on the tiger's head.

lines.text: 호랑이는 혹을 달고 산속으로 줄행랑! 다시는 오지 않았대요.
lines.en: The tiger ran off into the mountains with a bump on its head! And they say it never came back again.
segs: The tiger ran off into the mountains with a bump on its head! And they say it never came back again.

lines.text: 하늘 나라에 간 오빠는 해님이, 동생은 달님이 되었어요.
lines.en: In the land in the sky, the brother became the Sun, and the sister became the Moon.

lines.text: 동생이 말했어요. "오빠, 나는 밤이 무서워요."
lines.en: The sister said, "Big brother, I am scared of the night."
segs: Big brother, I am scared of the night.

lines.text: "그럼 우리 바꾸자!"
lines.en: "Then let's switch!"

lines.text: 그래서 동생은 해님, 오빠는 달님이 되었답니다.
lines.en: So the sister became the Sun, and the brother became the Moon.
segs: So the sister became the Sun, and the brother became the Moon.

lines.text: 해님이나 달님을 톡 눌러 봐요! 낮이 되고, 밤이 돼요.
lines.en: Tap the Sun or the Moon! It becomes day, and it becomes night.
segs: Tap the Sun or the Moon! It becomes day, and it becomes night.

lines.text: 해님 달님은 오늘도 하늘에서 우리를 환하게 비춰 준답니다.
lines.en: Even today, the Sun and the Moon shine brightly on us from the sky.
segs: Even today, the Sun and the Moon shine brightly on us from the sky.

lines.text: 두 목소리를 들어 봐요. 하나는 진짜 엄마, 하나는 가짜예요.
lines.en: Listen to the two voices. One is the real Mom, and one is a fake.

lines.text: 1번 목소리.
lines.en: Voice number one.

lines.text: 2번 목소리.
lines.en: Voice number two.

lines.text: 진짜 엄마 목소리는 몇 번일까요?
lines.en: Which number is the real Mom's voice?

lines.text: 진짜 엄마 목소리를 톡 골라 봐요! 다시 들으려면 한 번 더 눌러요.
lines.en: Tap the real Mom's voice! Tap once more to hear it again.

lines.text: "어흥~" 이건 호랑이가 흉내 낸 목소리예요!
lines.en: "Roar~" That is the tiger pretending to be Mom!

lines.text: 엄마 목소리는 다정하고 부드러웠어요. 다시 들어 봐요.
lines.en: Mom's voice was warm and gentle. Listen again.

lines.text: 맞아요! 진짜 엄마 목소리예요. 그런데 문밖 목소리는 걸걸했지요?
lines.en: That's right! It is the real Mom's voice. But the voice outside the door was rough, wasn't it?

cut_mimic: Ahem, I'll pretend to be Mom~
call_mom: Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~
call_tiger: Kids~ Mom's home. Open the door~

ui.해님 달님이 늘 우리를 비춰 줘요!: The Sun and the Moon always shine on us!
ui.창호지 구멍: A Hole in the Paper Door
